worldcombat.skill.tropkick.summary: Sinks its weight, steps in and drives a low, southern-heat kick into the target's planted leg: the hit deals contact damage and lowers its Attack by one stage; on a hit the user withdraws its foot and backs off a short half step to reset (staying put if there is no room behind). The fastest kick with the shortest cooldown, and a whiff just pulls the foot back.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.use.0: Cut a target's physical output up close
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.use.1: Use the fastest kick to disarm a threat first
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.use.2: Back off a little as you retract the kicking leg
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.description.0: The kick deals about %1$s contact damage on impact.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.description.1: Steps up to %1$s blocks toward the aimed direction (%2$s blocks per tick) with a %3$s-block collision radius; it stops and settles on contact, on being blocked, or once the distance is spent, and whiffs if it never touches a body.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.description.2: A hit lowers the target's physical Attack by %1$s stage, so the physical damage it deals drops; the kick does not move the target.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.description.3: On a hit the user withdraws about %1$s blocks in the opposite direction to reset; if there is no room behind, it stays put.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it recovers for %3$s, spends %4$s PP, and goes on cooldown for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.growth.0: From level %1$s the kick rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.growth.1: From level %1$s the kick rises again to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.tropkick.preference.ai: The companion only kicks once the target is within this distance; larger values kick earlier and miss more before the step lands.
On: a target with a lower health ratio ranks higher so the fastest kick goes for the kill. Off: ordinary melee ordering.
